page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Above the text: a woodcut ornament. Page number at the head. Dedication title in large italic and roman capitals, then a drop-capital paragraph. Signature "A 2" at the foot.

main_text.head: MAGNIFICO ET AMPLISSIMO VIRO, VIRTVTE, eruditione, prudentia verè nobili Domino TYCHONI BRAHE de Knudstrup, fundatori Arcis URANIBURGICAE in lectissima Hellesponti Danici Insula HUENA; Sideralis scientiae scrutatori, instauratori, conservatori unico, Domino & fautori meo summè colendo S.
main_text.p: ANnus jam fermè secundus agitur, Magnifice & generose Domine TYCHO, ex quo in illustrissima Schola Sigenensi, quae tum primò Herbornâ istuc translata est, quorundam instinctu & rogatu impulsus, de NATURA CAELI thesis quasdam meditari & conscribere occoepi. Argumentum ingens & ingenuum ex tam angusto ac humili (cujusmodi in me esse lubens fateor) ingenio longè majus. Aggressus tamen, ut potui, suscepram hanc de Caelo disceptatiunculam : pauculis quibusdam hac

page.notes: Drop capital "A" is a large woodcut initial, joined to "Nnus" as "ANnus". Some letters in the ornament and initial are uncertain. Long s rendered as s throughout. "suscepram" is printed as "fuscepram"-like form; read as suscepram [?].
